text:
maya: Quick check — onboarding new Acadia org. Need GPU quota increases (A100 / T4), VPC egress & ENI limits. Drafting a short cross-cloud provisioning checklist. Anyone done us-west2 + eu-west1 lately?

ravi: I handled us-west2 last month. For GCP request use Cloud Console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas, pick metric "NVIDIA A100 (a100-40gb)". Attach billing and justify. @maya what's target numbers?

maya: Target: us-west2: 16 A100s, 50 T4s; eu-west1: 8 A100s, 20 T4s. Also need subnetwork IP ranges: /20 for prod, /21 for staging, /22 for infra. Need tags/labels: org=acadia, env=prod/staging/infra, cost-center=acadia-prod. IAM roles: infra-admin, infra-operator (least priv), billing-viewer. Service account: redwood-inference-svc with roles/compute.instanceAdmin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser.

jess: For GCP include this in the quota request body (paste):

```
Project: projects/ACADIA-PROD
Quota: A100 GPUs (a100-40gb)
Current: 0
Requested: 16
Reason: Production inference capacity for model-serving; include estimated monthly spend and contact (maya@redwood.com)
```

ravi: Also request expected QPS & per-node footprint so support can recommend capacity. Helps speed approvals.

samir: On AWS side — p4d are account-level with special capacity steps. For now request 8 p4d in us-west-2 via AWS Support (Service Limit Increase). For T4/g4dn use EC2 quota "Running On-Demand G4dn instances". Also increase ENI and VPC IP per AZ: check quotas like "Network interfaces per instance" and "IP addresses per subnet". Ask network team for IP plan.

maya: Can someone paste the AWS case template? I'll file.

jess: Template I used:

```
Subject: Request limit increase for EC2 (p4d, g4dn) and ENIs in us-west-2
Case details:
- Limit: Running On-Demand p4d.24xlarge
- Current: 0
- Requested: 8
- Use case: Production LLM inference, need predictable capacity for Redwood Dedicated testing.
- Contact: maya@redwood.com, +1-555-1212
- Attach: architecture diagram, expected monthly spend estimate
```

ravi: Network egress on GCP — request increases for Cloud NAT ephemeral ports and external bandwidth if we'll pull model artifacts. Also check Global Forwarding Rules and static IP per project limits if we use LBs.

maya: Good call. I'll add Cloud NAT and Cloud Router quotas. Also tagging: enforce labels via org policy, provide terraform snippet:

```
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "prod" {
  name = "prod-subnet"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.10.0.0/20"
  region = "us-west2"
  labels = { org = "acadia" env = "prod" cost_center = "acadia-prod" }
}
```

ops-bot: ticket created: INC-4278 (GCP quota request). AWS case: AWS-31245. I'll add links when available.

samir: FYI region constraints: eu-west1 had limited A100 inventory last time — add fallback to eu-west3 or us-central1 and request capacity there too. Maybe mark "regional fallback acceptable" in support notes.

maya: Noted. For rollouts: request soft allocations for staging first (4 A100), then promote to prod after smoke tests. Add canary policy to rollout docs.

jess: Also ensure KMS/HSM key provisioning for Private deployments; include KMS quota and key rings in request. Security wants key rotation policy in the ticket.

maya: I'll prepare the actual support case drafts. Can people review the wording later today? Aim to file before EOD.

ravi: I can review after lunch. @jess @samir any blockers?

jess: none, lgtm.

samir: none here. I'll confirm AZ-level ENI numbers with network.

maya: Thanks — saving these notes. Will post final drafts here before filing. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add billing account ID and attach cost estimate spreadsheet to quota requests. :calendar:
